description: Use when you are the verified owner and you are posting a planned price or payTo. Free (owner session + signature required). Verified owner posts a planned price and/or payTo with effective_at, sig_b64, session.

host.description: Seller hostname or URL, for example api.agentweather.io

note.description: Optional short plain-text note (up to 500 chars)

planned_price_usd.description: Planned USD price >= 0, e.g. 0.02 (planned_price_usd or payto required)

sig_b64.description: Base64 Ed25519 or P-256 signature over canonical statement

name: seller_announce
title: Seller statement (Free, owner)
